sections.extract: 1 Introduction Substandard and falsified medical products pose a multilayered threat to the stability of health systems. They endanger health, through either therapeutic failure or adverse effects, and they undermine public trust in health care. They also risk jeopardizing global efforts working to suppress antimicrobial resistance, threatening the long-term efficacy of key life-saving medicines. Further to their
